title: Pandas performance boundaries
summary: Know when a single-machine DataFrame is no longer the right execution model.

blocks.text: Know when a single-machine DataFrame is no longer the right execution model.

items: Vectorization usually beats row-wise apply for standard numeric/string operations.
Reduce columns and rows before expensive operations.
Profile memory as well as runtime.
Move to a distributed engine when data or workload no longer fits the memory/latency envelope of one machine.

blocks.question: When should you not replace Pandas with Spark?
blocks.answer: When the dataset fits comfortably on one machine and the workload is interactive or low-latency; Spark adds scheduler, serialization and distributed-system overhead.
